text: I had a very bad experience with trip advisor because I set this tour as a Mexican and my tour are rejected, then I signs by USA page and I revive the same tour but double the price. Finally we visit the Real Alcázar but this is kind a for of racism or abuse
author: 727nataliad

title: We managed to enter the Alcázar 24 hours before without reservation on the eve of Easter
text: I bought this tour the day before I did it, tried many ways and here it was achieved. It was a complex thing that accommodated my schedule but our guide Roberto exceeded expectations and all Laura's attentions to get the tickets were worth the cost.
author: 727nataliad

title: Wonderful tour of Alcázar
text: Rosa was a wonderful guide. Lovely tour, very informative and enjoyable. Small group and early on the morning makes such a big difference in the enjoyment of the Alcázar.
author: Chris_E

title: Wonderful private tour
text: Robert was a wonderful guide and really helped us understand the palace.  He was able to explain things that we would never have understood had we visited on our own.  We would highly recommend this tour especially since tickets are difficult to get if you wait until that day.
author: Shelly_S

title: Delightful experience
text: My wife  and I had a tour with this company because a friend recommended them. The experience was delightful, and the knowledge of the guide was huge. He answered all our questions and gave us some fun facts! Also, we had full access to every corner on the stunning cathedral among other buildings, no long queues on the Sevillian weather at all!!! Thanks Sevillaconguia for an amazing experience, hope we will see you soon
author: carlosoX3228BN

title: Unforgettable experience
text: An unbeatable experience. The very friendly Guide explained everything in detail and we visited Top-rated places in Seville. If you go to the Spanish city and do not want to miss anything do not hesitate, you have to hire this Tourist Guide. Un 10.
author: 776richyg

title: Great way to see the Alcazar!
text: We had a good tour of the Alcazar.  We were to 1st tour of the day, and we made a beeline for the center of the Alcazar when no one else was there!  So, we had pictures and Javier’s comments alone in many of the inner spots.  Throughout the rest of the tour, his energy and knowledge were a great gift to learning and understanding more of the history of the wonderful site.
author: Peter_W
